enable.title: Bolt the vault door
enable.subtitle: Confirm it is you to turn the lock on

disable.title: Unbolt the vault door
disable.subtitle: Confirm it is you to turn the lock off

door.title: The door is bolted.
door.body: Use your fingerprint, face or screen lock to open it.
door.bodyDevice: Use your screen lock to open it.

notice.cancelled: The door stays bolted until you confirm it is you.
notice.failed: That did not open the door. Try again.
notice.lockout: Too many tries. Wait a moment, then try again.

unavailable.title: This phone has no screen lock.
unavailable.body: A door needs a bolt. Set a fingerprint, PIN or pattern in your phone's settings, then turn the vault door back on in your quarters.
